common_name: Middle Triassic Muschelkalk Ammonoid (Serrated Lobes, D_f=1.34)
cohort: Turing Reaction-Diffusion Wavelength Selection (1. Chemical Turing / RD)

phenomenon_scale.note: 26 µm label; stored size 2.56e-05 m = 25.6 µm so that 32 mm / 25.6 µm = 1250 wavelengths exactly.

paleobiology.chronoseries_note: Single Ladinian horizon in this slot. Predecessor and successor are the neighbouring suture-series taxa, not additional Ceratites chronospecies.

state_variables.role: activator / pigment precursor on the mantle epithelium

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg (1979): f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v
pde: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + a - u + u^2 v
dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + b - u^2 v
equations.turing_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (det J / (Du Dv))^(1/2), with det J = fu gv - fv gu
equations.onset_ratio: Dv/Du at onset solves Dv fu + Du gv = 2 sqrt(Du Dv det J)
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = largest eigenvalue of J - k^2 diag(Du, Dv)

boundary_conditions.reason: The k_c derivation expands perturbations as Fourier modes e^{ikx} on a periodic or infinite domain.

parameters.note: Du and Dv are solved from k_c and the onset ratio. They are not copied from the 1.088 mm sibling slot.

empirical_claims: At the operating ratio 1.15 times onset, the 2D Schnakenberg field on an 8-wavelength patch selects lambda = 26 µm (2.56e-05 m).
Equal diffusion (Dv = Du) is below onset: the largest linear growth rate is negative and a perturbation decays.
Raising the inhibitor/activator diffusion ratio at fixed Du lengthens the selected wavelength.
A 32 mm Ceratites nodosus shell spans 1250 wavelengths of 25.6 µm; the 1.088 mm organ-scale rib spans 42 of those wavelengths.
The vendored shell photograph supports segmentation of coiling and nodes. It does not resolve 26 µm pigment.
